arguments.body:
Thank you for the notification regarding the delivery failure for vessel manifest MISI-2024-882.

We have received your alert about the DNS resolution failure for recipient domain customs.gov when attempting to deliver to resync@customs-edi-router.net.

Our team is investigating this issue and will update the vessel scheduling system accordingly. We will contact you directly if we require further information or if the issue persists.

Please advise if there are any immediate actions needed from our side to facilitate customs clearance for this vessel.

Best regards,
Meridian Maritime & Freight Operations
